mechanism: Chlorpromazine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing letrozole plasma concentrations and bone marrow suppression risk; additive effects on CNS and orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor for letrozole toxicity (bone marrow suppression, hepatotoxicity); consider alternative antipsychotic with minimal CYP450 inhibition if feasible; counsel on CNS effects and orthostatic precautions.
